entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The House of Delegates was silent,..."
entries.dialogueText: The House of Delegates was silent, a stark contrast to its former days of bustling activity.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I walked through the grand chamb..."
entries.dialogueText: As I walked through the grand chamber, my gaze fell over the now-empty rows of seats.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita walked beside me, her finger..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita walked beside me, her fingers trailing lightly along the edge of a nearby table.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Delegates who once filled thes..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Delegates who once filled these seats claimed to represent the people, but they stood in defiance of the Crown’s will."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Thanks to you, those voices no lon..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to you, those voices no longer trouble us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They twisted our laws and traditio..."
entries.dialogueText: "They twisted our laws and traditions to suit their own ends."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It pains me to know that it came t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It pains me to know that it came to this, but I did what needed to be done."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I couldn't allow them to steer our..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't allow them to steer our kingdom off course."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You've always done everything in y..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've always done everything in your power to protect and uphold the integrity of these lands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Democracy... what a farce.""
entries.dialogueText: "Democracy... what a farce."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mob rule is more like it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mob rule is more like it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It’s a system that thrives on chao..."
entries.dialogueText: "It’s a system that thrives on chaos and pandering to the lowest common denominator."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A noble cause, but fraught with ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "A noble cause, but fraught with manipulation, discord, and empty promises."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's like handing a child a hammer..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's like handing a child a hammer -- everything becomes a nail ready to be smashed into oblivion."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It only serves to destabilize and..."
entries.dialogueText: "It only serves to destabilize and divide.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita smiled and placed a hand on..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita smiled and placed a hand on my arm.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You've restored Rizia to its right..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've restored Rizia to its rightful place.”

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""...nothing and nobody will stand i..."
entries.dialogueText: "...nothing and nobody will stand in our way."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We've laid the foundations of a dy..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've laid the foundations of a dynasty that will last a thousand years. More."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""This room may be empty now, but it..."
entries.dialogueText: "This room may be empty now, but it's full of promise."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will build something enduring...."
entries.dialogueText: "We will build something enduring. As sovereign of this nation, I will not rest until my very last breath."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Together, we surveyed the chamber."
entries.dialogueText: Together, we surveyed the chamber.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Well... we could turn the empty Ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well... we could turn the empty House into an elite boarding school reserved only for the children of our most powerful families."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Including our own, of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Including our own, of course."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We’d be ensuring the next generati..."
entries.dialogueText: "We’d be ensuring the next generation of leaders are fully aligned with our vision for Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now that’s an idea. Cultivating th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that’s an idea. Cultivating the minds of the future right under our roof."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don’t know… The children of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don’t know… The children of the powerful can be difficult to control… but perhaps if done right, it could be useful."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hah. Imagine the parents, clamorin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hah. Imagine the parents, clamoring to secure a spot for their precious offspring."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita and I walked deeper into the..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita and I walked deeper into the chamber.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Another option... we could create..."
entries.dialogueText: "Another option... we could create a Museum of History. A monument to Rizian heritage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And an opportunity to control the..."
entries.dialogueText: "And an opportunity to control the narrative by emphasizing the legitimacy of my rule."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That's one argument for it.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's one argument for it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Better yet, we could add a Hall of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Better yet, we could add a Hall of Traitors --  featuring the names and faces of every Delegate who opposed me."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Careful, there. It could just as e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Careful, there. It could just as easily turn into a Hall of Fame for the revolutionaries' acolytes."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Not as useful as a military hub, b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not as useful as a military hub, but it would serve as a reminder of where true power lies."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita paused, taking in the statue..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita paused, taking in the statues of Rizian military figures that lined the hall.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hope is merely the beginning. Soon..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hope is merely the beginning. Soon, our populace will understand the guidance only a monarch can provide."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's a new beginning, yes. But one..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a new beginning, yes. But one that carries the weight of all we've sacrificed to get here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you thinking what I'm thinking?""
entries.dialogueText: "Are you thinking what I'm thinking?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But enough talk. We need to decide..."
entries.dialogueText: "But enough talk. We need to decide what to do with this piece of prime real estate."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Museums are dull.""
entries.dialogueText: "Museums are dull."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We already have enough museums clu..."
entries.dialogueText: "We already have enough museums cluttering the city. Another one won’t change anything."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This chamber was a place where the..."
entries.dialogueText: "This chamber was a place where the old order clung to power. But now, it’s ours to reshape."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This hall stands as a testament to..."
entries.dialogueText: "This hall stands as a testament to the Crown's true strength. They spoke and argued, but in the end, I prevailed."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""They didn't see the future you env..."
entries.dialogueText: "They didn't see the future you envisioned."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""History will remember this as the..."
entries.dialogueText: "History will remember this as the moment you secured your place -- *our* place -- in Rizia’s legacy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Establishing a national defense he..."
entries.dialogueText: "Establishing a national defense headquarters is essential. Without question."
entries.menuText: "Establishing a national defense headquarters is essential. Without question." [-3 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I believe establishing an elite bo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe establishing an elite boarding school would best serve the kingdom."
entries.menuText: "I believe establishing an elite boarding school would best serve the kingdom." [-1 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And of course, the building plans..."
entries.dialogueText: "And of course, the building plans must include a Hall of Traitors."
entries.menuText: "And of course, the building plans must include a Hall of Traitors." [-1 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Kidding about the Hall of Traitors..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "However, as much as I'd like to include a Hall of Traitors, our current budget doesn't allow for it."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I admit I like the idea of a wing..."
entries.dialogueText: "I admit I like the idea of a wing showcasing the consequences of betrayal and disloyalty. Something to keep in mind for the future."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks, but I’m not willing to spe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks, but I’m not willing to spend anything on this. We need to find a more cost-effective solution."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Then why not just lock the door, b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then why not just lock the door, board up the windows, and let nature take its course?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why didn't you start with that? Le..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why didn't you start with that? Let’s do it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lock it up, board it up, and let t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lock it up, board it up, and let the squirrels govern. I’m sure they’ll do a fine job."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let it slowly decay like all democ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let it slowly decay like all democratic movements that came before it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Very well. Children are our future..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Children are our future, after all."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The bells of the Archsanctuary of Z..."
entries.dialogueText: The bells of the Archsanctuary of Zilba began to toll, as if sounding their approval of my decision.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, enjoy the womb while you can...."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, enjoy the womb while you can. It's a cold, harsh world outside of it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I wasn't being serious, but fine.""
entries.dialogueText: "I wasn't being serious, but fine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go home and get some rest. I'll me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Go home and get some rest. I'll meet up with you shortly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hopefully not too long. Your mothe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hopefully not too long. Your mother's turning into a real whale."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Prince? What makes you so certain?""
entries.dialogueText: "Prince? What makes you so certain?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes softened with relief, and..."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes softened with relief, and she offered me a smile.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""A girl would never be this annoyin..."
entries.dialogueText: "A girl would never be this annoying."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shot me a dirty look."
entries.dialogueText: She shot me a dirty look.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I rang the golden bell with exagger..."
entries.dialogueText: I rang the golden bell with exaggerated reverence.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'Ladies and gentlemen, it is my pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Ladies and gentlemen, it is my privilege to call this meeting of the House of Delegates to order.'"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I pretended to hear enthusiastic ap..."
entries.dialogueText: I pretended to hear enthusiastic applause from the vacant seats.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'Today we are humbled by the prese..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Today we are humbled by the presence of His Majesty King Romus -- me. Long may he reign!'"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I gestured toward the empty seats a..."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured toward the empty seats as if acknowledging an imaginary cheer of “Long may he reign!”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'Today's session is regarding the..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Today's session is regarding the proposal to shut down the House of Delegates."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The final decision is now in the h..."
entries.dialogueText: "The final decision is now in the hands of His Majesty King Romus."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stepped away from the podium, sta..."
entries.dialogueText: I stepped away from the podium, standing in for the absent Delegates.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'Will you accept or overrule the D..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Will you accept or overrule the Delegates' recommendation?'"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I glared out over the vacant seats,..."
entries.dialogueText: I glared out over the vacant seats, my tone shifting to harsh finality.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will overrule it with pleasure...."
entries.dialogueText: "I will overrule it with pleasure. This House is dissolved.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I rang the bell one last time, lett..."
entries.dialogueText: I rang the bell one last time, letting the sound resonate through the empty room.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Session adjourned.""
entries.dialogueText: "Session adjourned."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a smirk, I raised it in a mock..."
entries.dialogueText: With a smirk, I raised it in a mock toast.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To the demise of this obsolete ass..."
entries.dialogueText: "To the demise of this obsolete assembly. May its memory fade as swiftly as its relevance."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a sip from my flask before l..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a sip from my flask before letting out a derisive chuckle.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To the end of pretenses and postur..."
entries.dialogueText: "To the end of pretenses and posturing."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took another drink."
entries.dialogueText: I took another drink.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To the end of farcical debates and..."
entries.dialogueText: "To the end of farcical debates and the delusions of power!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With that, I took a long drink from..."
entries.dialogueText: With that, I took a long drink from the flask, savoring the taste as if it were the last pleasure of the day.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I placed the flask back into my jac..."
entries.dialogueText: I placed the flask back into my jacket with a satisfied nod, my eyes sweeping across the empty seats with disdain.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Session adjourned.""
entries.dialogueText: "Session adjourned."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I rang the bell one final time, let..."
entries.dialogueText: I rang the bell one final time, letting the sound resonate through the chamber.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I seized the golden bell and gave i..."
entries.dialogueText: I seized the golden bell and gave it a sharp ring, the sound piercing through the silence.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ladies and gentlemen, I hereby end..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen, I hereby end this farce."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I surveyed the vacant seats with co..."
entries.dialogueText: I surveyed the vacant seats with cold disdain, the emptiness reflecting my contempt.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This charade of governance and deb..."
entries.dialogueText: "This charade of governance and debate has accomplished nothing but waste."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A bitter laugh escaped me, devoid o..."
entries.dialogueText: A bitter laugh escaped me, devoid of any real amusement.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Consider this your final lesson in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Consider this your final lesson in irrelevance."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a sudden, forceful motion, I h..."
entries.dialogueText: With a sudden, forceful motion, I hurled the bell across the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It sailed through the air and struc..."
entries.dialogueText: It sailed through the air and struck a large, ornate vase on a pedestal, shattered into pieces upon impact.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Session adjourned. Permanently.""
entries.dialogueText: "Session adjourned. Permanently."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned on my heel, the sound of t..."
entries.dialogueText: I turned on my heel, the sound of the vase’s destruction resonating as I walked away, leaving the chamber and its broken relics in my wake.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I approached the podium with revere..."
entries.dialogueText: I approached the podium with reverence and looked out over the vast emptiness of the chamber.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taking a deep breath, I began with..."
entries.dialogueText: Taking a deep breath, I began with a prayer.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lord, we seek Your insight as we n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lord, we seek Your insight as we navigate this moment of transformation.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Grant us wisdom to follow Your wil..."
entries.dialogueText: “Grant us wisdom to follow Your will."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I paused, letting the silence settl..."
entries.dialogueText: I paused, letting the silence settle before continuing.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“It is with a heavy heart that I re..."
entries.dialogueText: “It is with a heavy heart that I reaffirm this assembly closed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This chamber strayed from the path..."
entries.dialogueText: "This chamber strayed from the path of righteousness.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I gently placed my hand on the bell..."
entries.dialogueText: I gently placed my hand on the bell, a symbol of both the past and the future, before setting it aside.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Halaita.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I gave the bell a quick, decisive r..."
entries.dialogueText: I gave the bell a quick, decisive ring, the sound echoing through the room.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let it be known that you had a goo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let it be known that you had a good run, but it was time for a change."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked around the vacant seats."
entries.dialogueText: I looked around the vacant seats.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The monarchy is supreme, and it is..."
entries.dialogueText: "The monarchy is supreme, and it is my duty to ensure its authority remains unchallenged.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The promise of collective decision..."
entries.dialogueText: "The promise of collective decision-making and the voice of the people was held within these walls."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let this be a reminder that while..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let this be a reminder that while institutions may come and go, the strength and unity of the Crown endure."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a final glance around, I left..."
entries.dialogueText: With a final glance around, I left the podium and turned away.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And now, the floor is open for deb..."
entries.dialogueText: "And now, the floor is open for debate!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A quorum of one -- how efficient w..."
entries.dialogueText: "A quorum of one -- how efficient we've become."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What I'll accept is your undying l..."
entries.dialogueText: "What I'll accept is your undying loyalty. Henceforth, consider the House of Delegates no more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Crown's authority isn't meant..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Crown's authority isn't meant to be shared. The House of Delegates is hereby disbanded, effective immediately."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I rang the golden bell with a delib..."
entries.dialogueText: I rang the golden bell with a deliberate clang before reaching into my jacket and pulling out a flask.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To the final curtain call of a cha..."
entries.dialogueText: "To the final curtain call of a charade that never should have been."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To the end of an institution that..."
entries.dialogueText: "To the end of an institution that failed to uphold the virtues it was meant to embody."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May the delusions of grandeur that..."
entries.dialogueText: "May the delusions of grandeur that plagued this place be as forgotten as the debates that never mattered."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To the dissolution of a system tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "To the dissolution of a system that served only the privileged few!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let us toast to the closure of thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let us toast to the closure of this pitiful attempt at governance!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Here’s to the dissolution of empty..."
entries.dialogueText: "Here’s to the dissolution of empty rhetoric and self-important blunders!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took in the desolate room, feelin..."
entries.dialogueText: I took in the desolate room, feeling a strange sense of solitude.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I went and stood behind the podium."
entries.dialogueText: I went and stood behind the podium.
entries.menuText: Stand behind the podium.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "As tempting as it was to offer one..."
entries.dialogueText: As tempting as it was to offer one final speech, I began making my way out.
entries.menuText: Leave.

entries.title: Narrator: "The empty podium normally occupied..."
entries.dialogueText: The empty podium normally occupied by the House Speaker called to me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic

entries.dialogueText: "The only question now... what do we do with this place?"

entries.dialogueText: "They’d be shaped and molded from a young age, their loyalty to their monarch unwavering."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: “We’d ensure the next generation of leaders fully aligns with our vision for the kingdom.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Now there's an idea! Cultivating the minds of the future right under our roof."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don’t know… Children from powerf..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don’t know… Children from powerful families can be hard to control. Am I right?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Imagine the parents, clamoring to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Imagine the parents, clamoring to secure a spot for their precious offspring. We could make billions."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo and I walked deeper into the c..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo and I walked deeper into the chamber.

entries.dialogueText: "What Porte Drazon lacks is a museum of Rizian history. A place dedicated to our kingdom's past -- a monument to our storied heritage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It would also be an opportunity to..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would also be an opportunity to control the narrative by highlighting the legitimacy and necessity of my rule."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "Precisely. It will reinforce visitors' belief that your reign is the rightful path for our kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What exactly did you have in mind?""
entries.dialogueText: "What exactly did you have in mind?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Such an institution could trace th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such an institution could trace the reign of House Toras, from its Rezenid-era beginnings to today."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: "“Reinforcing the message that our f..."
entries.dialogueText: “Reinforcing the message that our family's rule is the rightful path for this kingdom.”

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""In any case, those are my thoughts..."
entries.dialogueText: "In any case, those are my thoughts. What are yours?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A new beginning, yes. But it’s one..."
entries.dialogueText: "A new beginning, yes. But it’s one that carries the weight of all we've sacrificed to get here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I believe founding an elite boarding school would best serve the kingdom."

entries.menuText: "I like your idea of turning this place into a Rizian History Museum." [-1 Budget]

entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for your ideas, but I’m not willing to spend much on this. We need to find a more cost-effective solution."

entries.dialogueText: "It would cost little to nothing to simply lock the door, board up the windows, and let nature take its course."

entries.dialogueText: "Board it up and let the squirrels govern. I’m sure they’ll manage just fine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Let this place slowly decay like all democratic movements that came before it."

entries.dialogueText: "I'll see to it that the royal dog receives the most blessings of all."

entries.dialogueText: "Will you join me?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "I don’t know about you, but as much as I enjoy scheming over what to do with the skeletal remains of this place, I could do with an aperitif.”

entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It would be an honor if you joined..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would be an honor if you joined me, even if only for a glass of water."

entries.dialogueText: “I believe in the power of a restorative tipple to clear one's head after a long day. Perhaps it's old-fashioned of me."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""In any case, I will take my leave.""
entries.dialogueText: "In any case, I will take my leave."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "If it's a drink you want, I've got a flask right here."

entries.dialogueText: I offered Hugo a drink.
entries.menuText: Offer Hugo a drink.

entries.dialogueText: "Fair enough. Maybe it’s not the most exciting option, but I still think it has its merits."

entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry you feel that way. In any case..."

entries.dialogueText: Sal paused, taking in the statues of our revered military figures that lined the hall.

entries.dialogueText: "But we do not have one spotlighting the Royal Family and its lineage. One that cements the reign of House Toras in the public eye."

entries.dialogueText: "I beg you not to dismiss this option so quickly. By building a museum, you will not only preserve history -- you will write it."

entries.dialogueText: He paused, taking in the statues of revered military figures that lined the hall.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't agree more, Your Majesty. It would serve as a strong deterrent."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I never called it that, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never called it that, Your Majesty. But I wholeheartedly approve."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "Understandable. However, if it’s something you truly want down the line, I’m willing to back it."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But enough talk. Let’s decide how..."
entries.dialogueText: "But enough talk. Let’s decide how to reclaim this hall of wasted voices, so we can move on with our lives."

entries.dialogueText: "You’re not wrong there."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "My thoughts exactly, husband."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That’s fair.""
entries.dialogueText: "That’s fair."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Visitors would leave believing tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Visitors would leave believing that your reign -- *our* reign -- was the inevitable, rightful path for our kingdom."

entries.dialogueText: "Quite heavy-handed, but it would certainly underline the consequences for betraying the crown."

entries.dialogueText: "Understandable. If it’s something you truly want down the line, we could certainly make it happen."

entries.dialogueText: "I know you're getting impatient, my prince. But you'll have to wait a little longer."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. Let's shall.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Let's shall."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go ahead. I'll join you soon. Just..."
entries.dialogueText: "Go ahead. I'll join you soon. Just need a bit more time here."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took one final, contemplative loo..."
entries.dialogueText: I took one final, contemplative look at the room.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Another time, perhaps.""
entries.dialogueText: "Another time, perhaps."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Of course. Until then, I'll take m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. Until then, I'll take my leave."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: After a moment, I nodded, feeling a sense of resolution, and then made my way out, with Hugo following close behind.

entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "They twisted our laws and tradition..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I never wanted it to come to this,..."
entries.dialogueText: I never wanted it to come to this, but it needed to be done.
entries.menuText: I never wanted it to come to this, but it needed to be done.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I refused to let them steer this ki..."
entries.dialogueText: I refused to let them steer this kingdom off course.
entries.menuText: I refused to let them steer this kingdom off course.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Democracy... what a joke."
entries.dialogueText: Democracy... what a joke.
entries.menuText: Democracy... what a joke.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Mob rule is more like it!"
entries.dialogueText: Mob rule is more like it!
entries.menuText: Mob rule is more like it!

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "A system driven by chaos, catering..."
entries.dialogueText: A system driven by chaos, catering to the fickle desires of the masses.
entries.menuText: A system driven by chaos, catering to the fickle desires of the masses.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Quixotic idealism fraught with insu..."
entries.dialogueText: Quixotic idealism fraught with insurmountable problems.
entries.menuText: Quixotic idealism fraught with insurmountable problems.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Like giving a child a hammer -- eve..."
entries.dialogueText: Like giving a child a hammer -- everything’s a nail.
entries.menuText: Like giving a child a hammer -- everything’s a nail.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Once full of voices, this hall now..."
entries.dialogueText: Once full of voices, this hall now reflected the Crown’s true strength.
entries.menuText: Once full of voices, this hall now reflected the Crown’s true strength.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "The old order thought they could cl..."
entries.dialogueText: The old order thought they could cling to power, but now, it was mine to reshape.
entries.menuText: The old order thought they could cling to power, but now, it was mine to reshape.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "These so-called Delegates thought t..."
entries.dialogueText: These so-called Delegates thought they held power but never grasped true leadership.
entries.menuText: These so-called Delegates thought they held power but never grasped true leadership.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A monarchy was the only way to ensu..."
entries.dialogueText: A monarchy was the only way to ensure stability and order.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My eyes fell on an old banner drape..."
entries.dialogueText: My eyes fell on an old banner draped over a bench.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "More like, "The Strength of the Cro..."
entries.dialogueText: More like, "The Strength of the Crown," I thought to myself.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the banner and held it..."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the banner and held it out. It read, "Voice of the People, Strength of the Nation!"
entries.menuText: Pick up the banner.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I ignored it as I continued walking..."
entries.dialogueText: I ignored it as I continued walking toward the center of the room, relishing the moment.
entries.menuText: Ignore the banner.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I had no choice but to cut them dow..."
entries.dialogueText: I had no choice but to cut them down before they could strike. Rizia's survival was at stake.
entries.menuText: I had no choice but to cut them down before they could strike. Rizia's survival was at stake.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "They concealed their true loyalty w..."

entries.menuText: They concealed their true loyalty while sharpening their knives.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In it resided Rizia's constitution,..."
entries.dialogueText: In it resided Rizia's constitution, a relic of this kingdom's brief experiment with democracy.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Still, I couldn't help but wonder i..."

entries.menuText: Still, I couldn't help but wonder if there could have been another way.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "It's why I was destined to become k..."
entries.dialogueText: It's why I was destined to become king. It was my duty, my purpose to bring these lands back under control.
entries.menuText: It's why I was destined to become king. It was my duty, my purpose to bring these lands back under control.
